thread.title: Apple stock rises after Foxconn reports earnings

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple stock rises after Foxconn reports earnings
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) are up 0.2% in Monday trading after iPhone manufacturer Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., better known as Foxconn, reported quarterly earnings results. The company reported a weaker-than-expected net profit, according to the Wall Street Journal (https://www.wsj.com/articles/foxconns-profit-drops-as-iphone-shipment-growth-slows-1526306939). Foxconn's report comes a few weeks after Apple itself posted results and delivered lower-than-expected iPhone unit sales. Some investors were expecting Apple's iPhone X to drive a "supercycle" of phone upgrades after its launch last fall, but device sales have underperformed those projections. Apple shares are up 21% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has gained 19%.
-Emily Bary; 1237ET
